findings.title: Empty price lists now raise ZeroDivisionError
findings.description: Removing the empty-list guard makes average_price([]) evaluate sum([]) / len([]), which divides by zero. This breaks the existing test_empty expectation in test_pricing.py:9 that an empty input returns 0.0 and can crash callers that previously relied on that behavior. Restore the guard or otherwise handle empty input explicitly.
